---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug to help us improve iOS Backup Explorer
title: '[Bug] '
labels: bug
---

**IMPORTANT: Do NOT include your backup password, your data (messages, names, numbers, health values...), screenshots of your data, or file paths that name you. Describe the shape of the problem instead, or reproduce it with the demo backup (`python tools/make_demo_backup.py <folder>`).**

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what the bug is.

**To reproduce**
1. Open iOS Backup Explorer
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
Only of the demo backup, never of your own data.

**Environment:**
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14.2]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.11]
- iOS Backup Explorer version: [`python ios_backup_explorer.py --version`, e.g. 2.0.0]
- iOS version of the backup: [e.g. iOS 17.2]
- Kind of backup: [encrypted / unencrypted / folder of extracted files]
- Which tab or table: [e.g. Calendar > Events]
